summary.headline: Max Estates Q2 FY27 pre-sales of about 2100 crores across 274 units; H1 pre-sales about 3200 crores, roughly 60% of FY26 full-year pre-sales.
summary.overview: Q2 FY27 pre-sales were about 2100 crores from 274 units, all from sustainable sales with no new launch in the quarter, led by Estate 361, Max 1 and Estate 105. Realisation rose to about 24,700 per sq ft from about 18,400 in FY24, and collections of 560 crores were roughly double the year-ago quarter. Reported profit was small (Q2 PBT 27.2 crore, PAT 4.7 crore) because revenue recognition waits for handovers, while marketing spend rose to 20 crore from 12 crore. Management added a Sector 59 Gurgaon project (GBV about 4000 crore, launch Q3 FY27) and two BD deals, taking total GBV to about 29,000 crore.

financial_highlights.change: No new launch in quarter; all sustainable sales
vs approx. 18,400 per sq ft in FY24
Roughly double the same quarter last year
External debt 2100 crore incl. 950 crore LRD; cash and equivalents 1900 crore

segments.name: Residential
segments.commentary: Launched 18,700 crore across residential and mixed-use; about 15,700 crore (83%) sold. Contracted revenue with estimated PBT of 4800-5700 crore yet to hit P&L, starting FY28 with Estate 128.

segments.name: Commercial leasing
segments.commentary: Max Towers, Max House and Max Square at 100% occupancy, 1.3 million sq ft leased; Q2 leasing income about 40 crore, broadly flat YoY. Portfolio rental potential about 700 crore at 100% stabilised basis.

segments.name: Max Services (facility management)
segments.commentary: Q2 revenue about 17 crore, up about 28% YoY.

guidance_outlook: Estate 128 phase 1 delivery on track for FY28; revenue recognition from handovers begins FY28.
FY27 construction spend about 1500 crore; OCF guided for the full year (about 2752 crore cited), not half-yearly.
Sector 59 Gurgaon (GBV about 4000 crore, 1.3 million sq ft, 7.25 acres) to launch in Q3 FY27; pricing not yet disclosed pending approval.
Business development target of 2-3 million sq ft per year within NCR; total GBV pipeline about 29,000 crore.
Commercial rental income run rate about 700 crore annually, aiming well beyond 1000 crore in near term.
West Delhi 84.7 acre project: 18-24 month approval timeline, first launch potentially around end FY29.
capex_capacity: Estate 128: towers 1 and 2 completed in phase 1; tower 3 superstructure complete; phase 2 slab work on 9 floors; FY28 delivery on track.
Estate 360: slab work at 6th and 11th floors.
Estate 316: slab work between 6th and 11th floors.
Cumulative concrete about 3 lakh cubic meters; Q2 pour about 60,000 cubic meters; 60 floors cast in Q2, about 30% up QoQ.

Noida Expressway commercial pre-leasing 3.1 lakh sq ft (about one-third of usable area), up from 90,000 sq ft; Max District Gurgaon about 2 lakh sq ft pre-leased. Both on track for occupancy certificates.
Kasiabal (Noida) MOU for 9.7 acres JDA: saleable potential 1.5 million sq ft, GBV 2500-3000 crore; subject to diligence and approvals. West Delhi 84.7 acre MOU signed.
demand_pricing: Management says NCR volumes were flat (about 14,000 homes sold Jul-Sep), while Max's volumes kept growing; NCR average prices up about 12%.
Over a third of new NCR supply in the quarter priced above about 3 crore; rising land costs in development authority auctions.
Office market: NCR gross leasing about 3.8 million sq ft in Q3 and 10 million sq ft in 9M; vacancy about 17%, down about 200 bps YoY; rentals up 6-10%.
Pre-leasing premiums: about 25% over micro-market at Noida Expressway; over 35% at Max District Gurgaon.
Cancellations described as immaterial across launch portfolio.
Payment plans structured for about 20-25% of sales value collected each year.

qa_highlights.question: Demand outlook in NCR and Gurgaon for Sector 59, pricing upside versus peer, and launch pipeline timing?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the macro market is stabilising but Max volumes kept growing. Sector 59 launch is on track for this quarter; pricing withheld pending final approval. Pipeline of more than 29,000 crore includes Estate 105 phase 2 and 361 phase 2.

qa_highlights.question: Sector 59 monetisation strategy: sell full 4000 crore inventory or phase it?
qa_highlights.answer: Too early to decide; strategy to be calibrated closer to launch to serve Max's best interest.

qa_highlights.question: Business development plans and whether more projects will be added to support FY28-29 launches?
qa_highlights.answer: Continue to target 2-3 million sq ft of additions per year in NCR; four identified projects worth about 14,000 crore are already acquired and ready for launch. Commercial additions also being pursued.

qa_highlights.question: West Delhi acquisition progress and first-phase launch timing?
qa_highlights.answer: Master plan notified; one sector has provisional development licence. Approval process 18-24 months, first project potentially around end FY29; no significant cost beyond land security.

qa_highlights.question: OCF for H1 and full-year outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: OCF is tracked annually; full-year OCF guidance of about 2752 crore cited.

qa_highlights.question: Max One revenue recognition timing and Sector 132 Noida commercial project details?
qa_highlights.answer: Max One commercial part expected in FY28 and residential part in FY30 (per question). Sector 132 is an auction participation still awaiting authority approvals; no area or rental details given.

risks_watch: Reported profit remains thin until handovers; Estate 128 revenue from FY28 is key to earnings conversion.
Sector 59 pricing and absorption (about 4000 crore GBV) unconfirmed; launch slipping beyond Q3 FY27 would delay the story.
Land and approval timelines for Kasiabal (MOU, subject to diligence), Noida regulatory-approval and auction parcels, and West Delhi are uncertain.
Marketing expense rising with sales intensity (20 crore in Q2 vs 12 crore YoY) will keep near-term margins under pressure.
Net debt is about 200 crore but construction spend of about 1500 crore in FY27 relies on collections weighted to H2.
summary.management_tone: Confident on demand and execution, citing sustained sales and pricing growth. Cautious and evasive on specifics: declined to give Sector 59 pricing, launch monetisation strategy, and timelines for auction and approval-stage land deals.
key_quotes: This takes our first half year H1 pre-sales to approximately 3200 crores across 521 units already about 60% of our full year FY26 pre-sales.
Our average realisation and the second quarter was about 24700 rupees per square foot compared with about 18400 rupees in FY24.
Cancellations remain immaterial across the entire launch portfolio.
At a premium of about 25% to the micro market.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Q2 PBT only 27.2 crore and PAT 4.7 crore on revenue of 50-53 crore, with marketing spend up to 20 crore from 12 crore, and the 4800-5700 crore contracted PBT only starts reaching the P&L from FY28.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: H1 pre-sales of about 3200 crore (521 units) are about 60% of FY26 full-year pre-sales, and management says Max volumes kept growing while NCR volumes were flat at about 14,000 homes in Jul-Sep.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Construction spend of about 1500 crore is guided for FY27 and the 4 projects worth about 14,000 crore are already acquired, but no new capex or plant is announced and the Kasiabal MOU and Sector 132 remain subject to approvals.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: Sector 59 (GBV about 4000 crore) launch is on track for Q3 FY27 and collections of 560 crore in Q2 were roughly double the year-ago quarter, but no revenue or margin guidance was raised and pricing is withheld.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: A slip in the Sector 59 Q3 FY27 launch would delay the story, and the 1500 crore construction spend relies on H2-weighted collections, though net debt is only about 200 crore.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: Sector 59 Gurgaon (GBV about 4000 crore, 1.3 million sq ft) is guided to launch in Q3 FY27, with pricing still pending approval.

rows.label: Residential revenue recognition from Estate 128 handovers
rows.why: About 15,700 crore of the 18,700 crore launched is sold (83%), and contracted revenue with estimated PBT of 4800-5700 crore has yet to hit the P&L, starting FY28 with Estate 128.

rows.label: Business development additions in NCR
rows.why: Management targets 2-3 million sq ft of NCR additions per year, with four projects worth about 14,000 crore already acquired and total GBV at about 29,000 crore, plus the Kasiabal MOU (GBV 2500-3000 crore, subject to approvals).

rows.label: Realisation uplift
rows.why: Average realisation rose to about 24,700 per sq ft from about 18,400 in FY24, with NCR average prices up about 12% and pre-leasing premiums of about 25-35% over micro-market.

tone.note: Management was confident on sustained sales volumes, pricing and Estate 128 delivery in FY28, but cautious and evasive on Sector 59 pricing, monetisation strategy and timelines for auction and approval-stage land; analysts pressed on those specifics.
